dct_description_sm: ATLAS is a land information system that uses GIS technology. It was developed though consultation with Northwest Territories communities, community governments, Aboriginal governments as well as other stakeholders. It has been designed with the needs of each of these groups in mind and fills an identified gap in the area of land administration.  For more information, please visit the Lands- Atlas website:
